mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy supporting corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 4.5% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increase > 0.3pp in a month but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: HOUST and INDPRO both decline for 2 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) combined with elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 0.5% monthly growth indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth > 0.5% monthly but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 jobs signals labor market weakness, reducing household income and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS decline > 100k in a month but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of events.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate investment and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 0.5% monthly) combined with stable policy rates (FEDFUNDS within 0.25pp of prior month) indicates sustainable economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS stable but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
